messages:
alex-sales: FinanceCloud wants a 6-week technical POC. Requirements: VPC + customer KMS, audit logs, acceptance by week 6. Target: p95 latency <200ms for short prompts, cost goal approx $400 / 1M tokens. They can supply 2.5k labeled prompts.

lee-eng: Thanks. What's their expected traffic pattern? That changes Dedicated sizing and batching strategy.

alex-sales: They estimate steady 40 qps with spikes to 220 qps during nightly scoring. Median prompt length ~80 tokens; 95th <128.

ops-ryan: For 40 steady + 220 burst, Dedicated reserved pool recommended. Hosted could handle but burst guarantees are tricky. We'll need peering for VPC and PS support to onboard.

tessa-solutions: Draft acceptance criteria suggestion:
- Accuracy: 95%+ on 100 customer-selected critical prompts
- Latency: p95 <200ms for <=128-token prompts at 40 qps sustained
- Cost: modeled operating cost <=$400 per 1M tokens (we'll show two model options)
- Security: VPC + customer KMS configured, sec questionnaire cleared (no major risks)
- Reliability: no more than 60s total downtime during the acceptance window

mike-ml: For evals I'll split their 2.5k into 80/20 train/eval with a 100-case critical set they flag. We'll run our eval harness (accuracy, BLEU-ish domain metric, and side-by-side diff). Can they provide labels for the critical 100?

alex-sales: I'll ask them to flag and send labels this week. Timeline: they want infra ready in 10 business days and acceptance test completed by end of week 6.

lee-eng: Model & infra recs: open-nlm-7b q4 or q8 depending on cost. On A10-like nodes we see p95 ~120-180ms for small prompts with tuning. If they want better tail, use smaller batch sizes and disable RK caching for critical cases. We'll produce numeric estimates for both q4 and q8.

ops-ryan: Runbook notes: canary deploy, monitor token rate and latency per route, automatic fallback to hosted variant if Dedicated pool pressure >90%. Need alerting thresholds and an on-call playbook for failover.

alex-sales: Procurement wants predictable pricing for 6 weeks. Options?

tessa-solutions: Offer options: (A) Short-term reserved capacity: weekly commit with discount (recommended) or (B) PAYG with burst surcharge. I'll add numbers in the one-pager. Also note default data retention 30 days; legal may request longer.

security-bot: Attach sec questionnaire v3: https://redwood.internal/sec/q-template. For KMS: we need key ARN, rotation schedule, and list of IAM principals.

mike-ml: I'll run a small subset (200 prompts) today and post preliminary accuracy/latency numbers. Lee please include the sample cURL snippet for the eval call used in the harness.

lee-eng: Sample API snippet for inclusion:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \\
  -d '{"model":"open-nlm-7b-q4","input":"Summarize payment record"}' \\
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

alex-sales: Can someone create a concise one-pager (acceptance checklist + pricing options + setup checklist) by tomorrow EOD? I'll present to their technical buyer.

tessa-solutions: I'll assemble the one-pager and include the two pricing options, model/quantization tradeoffs, and a bullet runbook. Review 9am PST tomorrow?

ops-ryan: I'll prepare the VPC/KMS onboarding checklist and peer contact template.

mike-ml: Posted initial run for 200 prompts: accuracy on sample 200 = 93%, p95 latency = 150ms on q4 with dedicated A10 pool, cost estimate ~ $360 / 1M tokens (projected). Will refine after full eval.

alex-sales: Excellent. Meeting 9am PST tomorrow to finalize the one-pager and commit option. Thanks all :thumbsup:
